_comment: Market Update stats (content/copy.md › Market Update › Stats). Update monthly; text is shown word for word.

stats.label: Median sale price
stats.note: Median sale price rising from $1.8M to $2.2M year-over-year reflects continued price appreciation, meaning buyers are operating in a higher-cost market with increased competition pushing overall values up.

stats.label: Median Days on Market
stats.note: Days on market holding steady suggests buyers don't necessarily have more time to hesitate—well-priced homes are still moving quickly, so hesitation can still mean missing out on the best opportunities.

stats.label: Median Sale vs List
stats.note: Buyers are competing more aggressively and pushing prices further above list than last year.

stats.label: Months of Inventory
stats.note: At the current sales pace, all available homes on the market would sell in about 30 days, indicating a very strong seller's market.
